_about: Kate McCosh Clark's A Southern Cross Fairy Tale (London, 1891), a fairy story set in New Zealand and drawing on Maori legend. The Gutenberg catalogue also lists Andreas Reischek and A. P. W. Thomas (1857-1937) as annotators and Robert Atkinson as illustrator. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
